_comment: Shot list for episode 16, the last of six on sight lost and not given back. 18 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep16_between_the_pillars/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's picture, the series picture (site_batch2/15), the hall from the end of episode 15 and Ahijah inside his house (episode 15), the bronze shackles and Jerusalem besieged (episode 11), Isaac in the tent (episode 12), Jacob's crossed hands (episode 13), Henry's study and Josephus in Rome (episode 7), the temple court from episode 1, the episode map (maps/ep16.png). Nobody's face is shown: people are seen from behind, far off, in silhouette, or as shapes against the light. Nothing graphic: the blinding is not pictured, the fall of the hall is not pictured, Delilah's room is a sleeping man and a seated woman from behind. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Philistia and the hill country of Israel in the time of the judges unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and solemn, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
